content:
Context: Hostel Aocommodatien

Coverage of date of priority for GPRA in certain matters such as regularization, calculation of licence fee, etc.-After introduction of Automated System of Allotment of GPRA, in cases of regularization, calculation of licence fee, the date of priority of an officer will be considered to have been covered in a particular area/ locality if any junior officer has been earlier allotted the same type of accommodation, on regular allotment. OM, dated 23-7-2015.
